verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms Missive publishes a full llms.txt index at missiveapp.com/docs/llms.txt and serves every doc page as markdown via .md suffix, including the MCP-server doc that names the hosted agent endpoint — exactly what an AI agent would use to self-orient on agent-oriented docs. Earlier root-path probes (llms.txt/docs.md at bare domain) 404'd, showing the file isn't at the naive root location, and there's no independent/community confirmation of agents actually consuming it. Missing for 10: root-level llms.txt (only nested under /docs/), and independent hands-on confirmation of an agent successfully using it.
